plans.objective: [DIM: structure] The solution space of small feedforward networks interpolating analytic constraints exhibits a phase transition in capacity N_c(w) at critical sample size w_c, where rigid (low-dimensional) behavior transitions to fat (high-dimensional) behavior as the constraint manifold becomes underdetermined.

steps.description: Implement the bootstrap experiment to verify zero-violation reachability using a linearly separable constraint family (rigid case). This constructs a minimal working example with w=3, width=16, seed=42, training steps=1000, learning_rate=1e-3, and validation threshold ≤1e-3. The script will output the anchor configuration (width, training violation, validation violation) to prove the experimental setup can achieve zero violation before proceeding to the full N_c(w) scan.
